trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The reward for finishing everything else: all story chapters, side strands, collectibles and activities. Work through the roadmap in order, tick each trophy off in the tracker as you earn it, and the platinum unlocks automatically once the last one lands. It needs no separate step of its own — it is a progress marker, not a task.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing, which the game starts you on. Follow the on-screen objectives through the mission; it is unmissable story progress, so just play through the opening until the mission-complete screen appears.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 by playing through its missions in order. Keep following the story markers; chapter trophies unlock as the story advances, so there is nothing extra to hunt down.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 by playing through its missions in order. Story progress is tracked by the game itself, so this unlocks naturally as you finish the chapter's last mission.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 by playing through its missions in order. No side work is needed — finish the chapter's missions and the trophy follows.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 by playing through its missions in order. Keep pushing the story forward; the trophy unlocks when the chapter's final mission ends.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. Play the last story mission through to its end; the trophy unlocks with the finale. Save before the finale if you want a clean point to return to for post-game cleanup.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a named story mission, so follow the story marker when it appears and play it through to completion.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are story beats: follow the mission marker, complete each objective, and the trophy unlocks at the mission's end.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It is a named story mission, so play it when the story offers it and finish it to unlock the trophy.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Follow the story marker to the mission, play it through, and the trophy unlocks on completion.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It is a named story mission at the airport; follow the mission marker and finish it to unlock the trophy.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Follow the story marker, complete the mission objectives, and the trophy unlocks at the end.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. This is the long tail of the platinum: story, stranger strands, activities and collectibles all feed into it. Check the in-game stats or progress screen to see what is still missing, and work through the checklist in this guide. Which categories count toward 100% is not yet verified in-game.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list (100% progress target).

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts are the game's stunt jumps and ramps: hit them in vehicles, land cleanly, and the game counts each one. Spread the attempts across the map and use the tracker to watch the total climb; 250 is a grind, so chip away at it between story missions.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Sample everything the game offers at least one time — races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games, bowling and the rest. One attempt each is enough; you do not need to win or score well. The full list of activity types is not yet confirmed in-game.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — 42 challenges in total, according to the trophy list's tracked count. Practice each challenge's target pattern, keep your aim steady, and repeat a challenge until you hit the gold score. Work through them one weapon or range at a time.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (42 Shooting Range challenges); PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Learn each course's turns and shortcuts, and repeat a location until you win there — the trophy needs a win at each location, not just one win anywhere.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Vary the race type and location so each win counts as a different race; repeating the same race does not add to the count. Try street, off-road and other formats as they unlock.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Enter the fishing challenge when it is offered, follow the reeling prompts to land the catch, and outscore Cal to take the win.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game at any arcade machine. Pick a game you can finish in one sitting and play it through to the end; completion is what counts, not a high score.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Stranger missions appear as you explore Leonida; follow Andy's strand through its missions until the last one, then finish it.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's stranger strand to its last mission and complete it; the strand's missions unlock as you progress.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's stranger strand through to its final mission and finish it to unlock the trophy.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Explore the map for stranger markers, finish each strand's missions, and keep count in the tracker — eight full strands is the target, and the individual strand finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count toward it.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's stranger strand to its last mission and complete it.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's stranger strand to its last mission and complete it.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Visit each spot and complete the meditation prompt there. The exact spots are not yet confirmed in-game, so check them off in the tracker as you find them and revisit areas you have not fully explored.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand and the hunt prompt it gives you. The specific animal and its location are not yet verified in-game, so treat Bret's in-game directions as your guide and note what you find.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; collect full sets of cards and use the tracker to note which sets you have finished. Three completed sets is the target, not every card in the game.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. Each new location counts once, so spread your visits across the map rather than repeating one spot. Work through districts methodically and the count will climb.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges cover many activity types; open the game's challenge menu, work through its list, and tick them off as they complete. Fifty is a solid chunk of the full challenge list, so treat it as a long-term goal.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, reach a 4-star wanted level, then lose the police and escape the heat. Break line of sight, use alleys and cover, and stay hidden until the wanted level clears — the trophy needs the escape, not just the wanted level.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level. Plan a route between nearby shops, keep moving between robberies, and do not let the heat drop before the third shop is done.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Drive or enter new vehicle models as you come across them; the game counts each new model once. Explore car parks, roads and dealerships to find models you have not seen yet.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Find a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the kills before it ends. A busy firefight with clustered enemies is the best place to try it.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Head to the airport and leave by an aircraft outside the normal schedule. The exact trigger is not yet verified in-game, so try the airport's aircraft and airfield options and note what works.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhinos — the tank. Take the hint literally: get into a Rhino tank and play with it in the open world. The exact action the trophy wants is not yet confirmed in-game, so treat the description as your starting point and try the obvious tank antics.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Enter quietly, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take the goods and leave before any alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — detection is what fails it.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Plan an escape route before each robbery, grab the vault's contents, and leave the area cleanly — each vault counts once you are clear. Five separate vault jobs is the target.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, take the cash, then break away from any pursuit. A quiet stretch of road and a fast getaway vehicle help.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Travel the whole map — Vice City, the beaches, the swamps and the countryside — until the map is fully revealed. Drive, fly or sail into every corner; the in-game map shows what you have not covered yet.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Find each gang's operations across the map and hit one per gang. You will need to identify which gang runs each operation, so scout before you strike.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. It is a small moment trophy — just find the right place and drink.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle through the showroom's frontage and out onto the street. Pick a showroom, build speed inside, and go straight through the glass.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a follow-through. Play a round of bowling there; the trophy is about the follow-through, so finish your throw properly rather than rushing it.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description hints at a partnership achievement with broad appeal. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed in-game, so treat it as a partner-activity goal and check back once the community pins it down — do not chase a specific step until it is verified.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make a story choice — the description points to a decision with consequences, for better or worse. This is the one trophy the official descriptions mark as plausibly missable: a choice may only come once, so keep a save before major decisions and think before you pick. The exact choice points are not yet verified in-game.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description suggests succeeding on a second attempt — second time's the charm. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed in-game, so treat it as a retry-based goal and note what you were doing when it pops.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: An odd or unexplained event in Leonida — the description reads like an easter egg or strange encounter. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed in-game; keep an eye out for strange sights while exploring and note where you were when it happens.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: knock the pins over from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon at a bowling alley. The exact setup is not yet verified in-game, so try it at the Kolt & Associates alley with a vehicle and a melee weapon.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Collect marked bills from robberies and pass them through your contacts until the total reaches $250,000. It accumulates over time, so keep laundering as you play.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across the game's shops. Buy vehicles, clothes, weapons and upgrades; the total accumulates across all shops, so normal spending across a playthrough gets you most of the way there.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Visit each property for sale, check the price, and buy them all. Save up first — properties are a big spend, and the trophy needs every garage, not just one.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the app to register vehicles you own or find, until you reach ten. Any ten vehicles count, so register each new one as you get it.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.
